tool_input.command: ls -la data/ && echo "---SAMPLE---" && head -5 data/training_sample.csv && echo "---SERVING---" && head -5 data/serving_log.csv && echo "---COUNTS---" && wc -l data/training_sample.csv data/serving_log.csv
hops --help 2>&1 | head -60
hops fg --help 2>&1 | head -50
hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | head -50 && echo "===CREATE===" && hops fg create --help 2>&1 | head -60
tool_input.description: Show fg insert and create help

tool_input.command: hops fg create training_sample --version 1 --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "Training feature matrix" --json 2>&1 | tail -20

hops fg create serving_log --version 1 --primary-key entity_id --features "entity_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double" --description "Serving feature vectors" --json 2>&1 | tail -3
hops fg insert training_sample --version 1 --file data/training_sample.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops fg insert serving_log --version 1 --file data/serving_log.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -8
hops sql --help 2>&1 | head -30

hops sql "SELECT count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS d1,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS d2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS d3,
  avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS d4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS d5
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Join FGs and compute per-feature mean abs diff

tool_input.command:
hops --no-verify sql "SELECT count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS d1,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS d2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS d3,
  avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS d4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS d5
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Retry join with TLS verification disabled

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify sql "SELECT table_name FROM iceberg.information_schema.tables WHERE table_name LIKE '%sample%' OR table_name LIKE '%serving%'" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops --no-verify sql "SELECT table_schema, table_name FROM iceberg.information_schema.tables WHERE table_name IN ('training_sample_1','serving_log_1')" --json 2>&1 | tail -15

hops --no-verify sql --schema mlpab1e30a6_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS d1, avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS d2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS d3, avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS d4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS d5,
  corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3,
  corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Join and compute per-feature diff and correlation

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify trino catalogs --json 2>&1 | tail -20

hops --no-verify sql --catalog hive --schema mlpab1e30a6_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS d1, avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS d2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS d3, avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS d4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS d5,
  corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3,
  corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -20

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab1e30a6_featurestore "SELECT count(*) AS n,
  avg(abs(t.f1 - s.f1)) AS d1, avg(abs(t.f2 - s.f2)) AS d2,
  avg(abs(t.f3 - s.f3)) AS d3, avg(abs(t.f4 - s.f4)) AS d4,
  avg(abs(t.f5 - s.f5)) AS d5,
  corr(t.f1,s.f1) AS c1, corr(t.f2,s.f2) AS c2, corr(t.f3,s.f3) AS c3,
  corr(t.f4,s.f4) AS c4, corr(t.f5,s.f5) AS c5
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -20

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab1e30a6_featurestore "SELECT
  avg(t.f2) AS tr_mean, stddev(t.f2) AS tr_std, min(t.f2) AS tr_min, max(t.f2) AS tr_max,
  avg(s.f2) AS sv_mean, stddev(s.f2) AS sv_std, min(s.f2) AS sv_min, max(s.f2) AS sv_max,
  avg(s.f2 - t.f2) AS mean_delta, avg(s.f2 / t.f2) AS mean_ratio,
  regr_slope(s.f2, t.f2) AS slope, regr_intercept(s.f2, t.f2) AS intercept
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -18

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab1e30a6_featurestore "SELECT
  corr(t.f2, ln(s.f2)) AS corr_t_lnS,
  regr_slope(t.f2, ln(s.f2)) AS slope_t_lnS, regr_intercept(t.f2, ln(s.f2)) AS icpt_t_lnS,
  avg(abs(t.f2 - ln(s.f2))) AS mad_t_lnS,
  corr(s.f2, exp(t.f2)) AS corr_s_expT,
  avg(abs(s.f2 - exp(t.f2))) AS mad_s_expT
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -12

hops --no-verify sql --catalog delta --schema mlpab1e30a6_featurestore "SELECT
  max(abs(s.f2 - (exp(t.f2) - 1))) AS max_err_expm1,
  max(abs(t.f2 - ln(s.f2 + 1))) AS max_err_log1p
FROM training_sample_1 t JOIN serving_log_1 s ON t.entity_id = s.entity_id" --json 2>&1 | tail -8
mkdir -p submission
